Signed Binary Notice • Why Windows SmartScreen Still Prompts Temporarily

100% Cryptographically Signed: Every official RaggieSoft Studio download—including Universal Web & Offline Setup.exe launchers, inner x64 & ARM64 .msi databases, Installer Studio v0.5.0, and Accessibility Studio v1.0.0—is Dual-Layer Authenticode-signed via Microsoft Azure Artifact Signing (Verified publisher: Michael Ragsdale, RFC 3161 timestamped, and verified with signtool verify /pa).

Why SmartScreen may still say “Windows protected your PC” right now: Our Microsoft Public Trust signing certificate is brand-new (issued November 25, 2026). Under Microsoft’s current SmartScreen rules, newly issued certificates start at zero download reputation until initial install volume and Microsoft Security Intelligence (WDSI) review complete (already submitted). To install safely while reputation clears: click More info, confirm Windows shows Publisher: Michael Ragsdale (never “Unknown publisher”), and click Run anyway. Full details in the FAQ →

Which Edition or All-Access Suite Fits Your Workflow?

Recommended: Standalone Self-Extractor Utility (rswsfx.exe)

Standalone RaggieSoft Self-Extractor (rswsfx.exe — Built & Staged in v0.6.0)

If you only need to wrap a folder or .zip into a signed LZMS single-file .exe (including silent extraction to %TEMP%, launching an inner setup, waiting on child cleanup helpers like _ISDEL.EXE, and scrubbing %TEMP% afterward), our standalone Self-Extractor desktop & CLI utility (rswsfx.exe --pack) handles the job without needing a full MSI authoring IDE—and is also bundled inside every edition of Installer Studio!

Recommended: Free Community Edition (100% Architect Parity)

RaggieSoft Studio Community Edition Suite

Unlocks 100% of Architect Edition across all 8 Studio tools—including RaggieScript (.rssc), Showcase Studio bespoke _support\ canvas installers, .rsis Dual-Bar Suites, .MSP binary-delta patches, and automated HTML5 VPAT 2.5 exports—with zero watermarks!

Recommended: Commercial Tier 1 — Essentials

All-Access RaggieSoft Studio Essentials Suite

Built for 1-workstation guided commercial shipping: native x64 & ARM64 .MSI + Setup.exe, sfx self-extractors, .MSM Merge Module consumption, Major Upgrades, WCAG 2.2 AA runtime UI, and full Authenticode / Azure Artifact Signing.

Recommended: Commercial Tier 2 — Developer

All-Access RaggieSoft Studio Developer Suite

Unlocks RaggieScript (.rssc) across your tools, .MSM Merge Module creation, custom C++ & MSI.DLL dialog designers, legacy .CHM / VB6 .vbp / .slnx importers, msiprism.exe, SARIF 2.1.0 gates, and headless GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps build agents.

Recommended: Commercial Tier 3 — Architect

Unlocks Unified Multi-Product .rsis Suites (monotonic Dual-Bar progress + dynamic ARPSYSTEMCOMPONENT adoption), Showcase Studio bespoke _support\ canvas installers, .MSP binary-delta patches, federated cross-product Help & Translation Memory, and one-command HTML5 VPAT 2.5 conformance reports across every tool.
